attributes.action: Call for a general election. Labour isn’t capable of running our country anymore
attributes.background: Call for an immediate general election to ensure a democratic mandate for the Prime Minister. We believe that a change in leadership outside of a general election cycle warrants a fresh mandate from the electorate to ensure political legitimacy and public accountability.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
